summary: The Novo Nordisk Foundation offers five three-year Mads Øvlisen PhD scholarships in art history and in practice-based artistic and curatorial research, for projects that take place primarily in Denmark. Citizens of all countries may apply. Each grant is worth up to DKK 3,080,000 over three years. The call opened 29 October 2026 and closes 14 January 2027 at 14:00 Copenhagen time.
highlights: A completed master's degree or equivalent is required before applying.
Practice-based applicants need a substantial, documented artistic or curatorial practice.
PhD projects already initiated are not eligible.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Novo Nordisk Foundation page before applying.
